latest.title: The flexible part of intermittent Onsager theorem for the two-dimensional stochastic incompressible Euler equations
latest.abstract: This work is concerned with the flexible part of Onsager theorem for the two-dimensional stochastic incompressible Euler equations. We develop a stochastic and intermittent variant of the Newton--Nash iteration scheme, which incorporates new stochastic pressure, Reynolds stress and intermittency perturbations to formalize the stochastic and intermittent fluctuations. For any $γ\in \left[ {0,\frac{1}{3}} \right)$, we employ this iteration scheme to construct $γ$-Hölder-continuous martingale solutions for the two-dimensional stochastic incompressible Euler equations. These martingale solutions exhibit dissipative behavior and intermittency, thereby settling the flexible part of intermittent Onsager theorem for the two-dimensional stochastic incompressible Euler equations.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究随机流体方程的 intermittent Onsager 现象，通过 Newton–Euler–Reynolds 与 Nash 迭代构造 martingale solutions。
latest.breakthrough: Theorems 1.1–1.2 给出随机解的 Hölder/能量异常结论。
latest.limitations: 依赖噪声协方差、初始正则性及迭代参数范围；构造结论是概率/鞅意义下。

steps.claim: Newton–Euler–Reynolds scheme 逐步降低 Reynolds stress。
steps.route: Section 3 构造频率局部化扰动，解线性化 Euler–Reynolds 系统并控制速度、压力和 stress 的尺度。
steps.evidence: PDF 第18–30页，第3节 Newton–Euler–Reynolds system、Propositions/estimates。

steps.claim: Nash perturbation 恢复空间正则性并控制随机误差。
steps.route: Section 4 对速度加入 Nash 型微振荡，利用随机积分估计和参数选择使新 stress 满足下一阶归纳界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第31–43页，第4节 Nash iteration scheme。

steps.claim: Theorems 1.1–1.2 由 Section 5 归纳界和紧性闭合。
steps.route: 统一所有迭代误差后，用 martingale compactness 抽取极限并验证方程/能量性质，得到主定理。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–4页第1节 Theorems 1.1–1.2；第44页起第5节 Inductive estimates。
